name: MembershipIcon
description: 24px membership icon with original Figma artwork.

figma.notes: Verified from Figma design context and original SVG assets; Code Connect is not configured.

tier.description: Membership tier matching the Figma variant.

alt.description: Accessible name override. Defaults to the tier name followed by 会员; an empty string makes the artwork decorative.

artwork.note: Keep the four original SVG assets, their intrinsic dimensions, colors, and gradients. No CSS recoloring.

accessibility.ariaPattern: One accessible name on the root; internal SVG images are hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.notes: Use alt="" when an adjacent label repeats the tier. Original artwork text contrast follows Figma and is not an AA text-contrast claim.

testing.rationale: Static original artwork. Storybook verifies all four assets load; browser tests verify geometry and accessible naming.
